post.caption: All mined gold fits in one cube. By the end of 2025 about 220,000 tonnes had been mined, and gold is so dense that the pile is smaller than you think. The cube would be roughly 22 meters on each side. It would fill about four and a half Olympic pools. About 45 percent of it is jewelry. Mines add more than 3,000 tonnes a year. Estimates for gold still underground run from 55,000 to 66,000 tonnes. A gold treasure from Varna, Bulgaria is over 6,000 years old. That treasure holds about 3,000 gold objects.
